evidence_policy: Technical findings use original papers; surveys and third-party summaries used only for discovery, not evidence.
limitations: Targeted search, not exhaustive or systematic review.
Reading depth varies; no claim that every paper or appendix was read in full.
No code reproduction, independent figure digitization or proof verification.
P13 publisher forum/PDF requests met a browser-verification page; primary arXiv HTML used.
P22 publisher-linked PDF was rejected for application/octet-stream transport; abstract only.
P23 landing-record July submission conflicts with its 2609 identifier prefix; month not relied upon.
Unknown pretrained-LM data-generating causal model prevents automatic transfer of P09 identification assumptions.
search_strategy: focused code execution, variable-binding and structural probing searches
follow primary references and verify publisher records where accessible
